title: A window that pours into the dock
blurb: Two <dialog> windows and a dock of buttons. Minimise a window and it bends into a funnel and pours into its button, drawn as 2 pixel strips. The windows hold real form controls, which keep their state while they're away.
question: The macOS genie effect bends a window into a funnel. Can a 2D canvas do it to a <dialog> with one source-rectangle draw for each row, and is the window's hit box right when it comes back?
result: Yes. Up to 92 strips a frame drew at 60 paints a second in the test browser by source rectangle and by clip. Each strip moves the hit box, so the window is taken out of hit testing while it moves and one whole draw restores it.
